findings.summary: The producer cannot see the CI history result it is told to report
findings.evidence: The plan says that if `athena check --history` (ci.yml:606-607) fails on an old commit, "the producer reports it and does not weaken the rule". System facts say the producer works in a one-commit snapshot with no history, and CI runs only after the pull request opens at verification start. So the producer can neither run this check nor see its result. content.rs:93-102 does parse every past athena.toml that a commit changed with the current Config::parse, so the risk is real. The evidence that old configs are safe is only docs/decisions.md:327 and :725-726, which I read. Fix: Say that this risk is caught by the early pull request's CI run and judged at verification and landing, not by the producer. Have the producer's report state that the history check was not run locally and why.

findings.summary: Name the report field that excuses the unchanged briefs.rs
findings.evidence: briefs.rs is an expected deliverable with action modify, and the plan expects it to stay unchanged. The producer output has an `unchanged_planned_files` list with reasons (crates/athena-context/src/outputs.rs:135; run/send_back.rs:252). A reason given there excuses the file. The plan says only "the final report says why". Fix: In Step 8, tell the producer to list briefs.rs under unchanged_planned_files with its reason: its fixtures at :1477-1478 and :3549-3550 are plain struct fields that never reach Config::parse.

summary: I checked the plan against the snapshot with Read and Grep and accept it. The claims I checked match the code. Config::parse calls validate at config.rs:616-619. The plan puts the new check after the hard_producer_model check at :670-674. The Models fields the check reads have no serde default (:314-318). In athena.toml the only Haiku model is in producer_allowed, and the only Opus model is the verifier. jev::ENDPOINT and jev::MODEL exist at jev.rs:31-33, and lib.rs has `pub mod jev`. OLY-B-SET-02 at spec.toml:2019-2026 still says mechanism "none". The planned measure form matches what xtask spec.rs:204-210 and hestia measure_problem accept. shard-timings.txt has the external_calls_guard and refusal_corpus lines at 52-53. I grepped for every non-test caller of Config::parse (admission, capability, gh/records, gate lib/content/invariant, xtask setup, cli wiring). The dependents list covers all of them. No test fixture outside config.rs builds a [models] section with other model names, and no .rs file assigns models fields directly. The three removal cases in the unit tests are built so that no earlier error fires first: the haiku case keeps sonnet in producer_allowed, the sonnet case moves every role to haiku, and the opus case uses a verifier outside producer_allowed. Each demonstration names a real seam, the real loader. Soundness: matching by substring on model ids is a reasonable family test, and the plan rightly does not read [models.names]. Applying the rule to every athena.toml Athena loads, including users' repositories, follows the accepted reading, and the error text and changelog say so. There are two small findings. The producer cannot see the CI-only history-check risk it is told to report. The plan should name the report field that excuses the unchanged briefs.rs.
